text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC-2026-089 fired for inference-eu-01 — 5xx spike on /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate. Affected customers: multiple enterprise tenants. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/incs/embeddings-5xx

incident-bot: Bridge created and attached to PD incident (link: https://pd.example/INC-2026-089). Notifying on-call.

maya: I'm oncall — acked the PD incident and taking ownership here. tagging ops. :hand:

pagerbot: Ack recorded (maya). Escalation policy: 5m -> sam if no mitigation.

sam: Taking lead for triage. First checks: autoscaler, dedicated pool saturation, and recent deploys. @carla can you check deploy history around 09:00 UTC?

carla: No scheduled deploys in that window. Looking at kvcache metrics for eu region now — seeing a huge eviction spike on eu-kv-1 around the same time. Snippet from logs: ```WARN runtime.kvcache: eviction loop triggered, evicted=1234, reason=memory_pressure```

maya: Good catch. If kvcache evictions caused cold cache, embeddings will regenerate large state and spike CPU. Sam — can you check GPU saturation and queue length? Also please enable routing fallback to us-west temporarily.

sam: Quick checks: `kubectl -n inference top pod -l pool=eu-dedicated-1` shows cpu ~95% across workers, mem ~72%. There are 5 pending pods in the HPA queue. Looks like autoscale didn't trigger — quota limits. I'm applying a temporary replica bump and filing a quota request to eng-infra. Command run: ```kubectl scale deployment/inf-runtime --replicas=8 -n inference```

sam: Applied autoscale override (temporary). Also pushed a routing change to send ~12% of embeddings traffic to us-west as emergency fallback per routing policy.

pagerbot: Routing change applied: 12% -> us-west for embeddings. Monitoring for error rate delta.

carla: Customer impact update: CS reports multiple enterprise customers seeing degraded throughput and 4xx/5xx spikes — proactively notified them and opened tickets. Logged details to the incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incs/INC-2026-089

maya: Status update: after replica bump and partial traffic shift, embeddings error rate decreased from ~60% to ~20%. Still elevated but trending down. Next steps: check model rollout footprints and any recent model-config changes. Assigning follow-ups: eng-infra (quota), runtime (kvcache behavior), and model-ops for possible rollback.

sam: Investigated model-catalog: a recent change to `embedder-v2` enabled kv-prefetch and changed cache TTLs; rolled out to eu pool before spike. Initiating rollback to previous model version on eu-dedicated-1: `redwood models rollback embedder-v2 --pool eu-dedicated-1 --to embedder-v1`

incident-bot: Rollback job started (job id rb-2026-089). ETA ~8m. Will post completion.

sam: Rollback completed. Post-rollback metrics: errors down to ~2% and latency back to baseline. :thumbsup:

maya: Marking incident as mitigated — mitigation actions effective. Keeping incident open for postmortem/lessons learned. Immediate action items: update runbook with autoscaler threshold checks, add a prewarm step for kvcache during model rollouts, and review routing fallback percentage. Tagging @postmortem-team for follow-up.

pagerbot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED by maya. PD incident will auto-close in 30m if stable.

carla: Note for postmortem: correlate model rollout timestamp with kvcache evictions and autoscaler failures; propose adding an automated prewarm and an HPA sanity check that triggers quota request earlier.

sam: Added a short checklist to the incident doc: - request quota bump (eng-infra) - add autoscale alert (ops) - re-run staged load test for eu with embedder-v2 on a canary pool.

maya: Thanks team — handing back to rotation. I'll draft the postmortem and assign owners for each follow-up. :wave:
